minutes.headline: Finance Committee voted 4-2 to draft a Prop 2.5 override warrant article, with a public hearing set for March 14.
minutes.summary: The committee heard Council on Aging and Library budget presentations, with debate over benefited hours for the meal site manager, teen librarian hours and a hearing loop. It reviewed a draft grant-writing services letter to the Select Board, to be revisited next week. After long debate on timing, open meeting law and who should bring an override, it passed the chair's motion to draft an override article.

public_comment.topic: Said budget pie charts included non-discretionary debt, that schools are being targeted to lead an override, and cautioned on the grant writer and teen librarian expansion.
Defended Council on Aging benefits, said seniors are inexpensive residents, and asked for public comment after each budget presentation.

budget_items.what_was_said: Request exceeds the town manager's preliminary budget; state certification requires a minimum appropriation.
The town manager's preliminary budget carries a line for contracted grant writing services.

decisions.decision: Grant writing letter to be circulated and revisited, with vote next week; edits go only to the chair's designee, not the group.
Chair will arrange a public hearing for March 14 and add the override to the Feb 29 and Mar 7 agendas despite the motion passing narrowly.

what_happened.line: The Finance Committee voted 4-2 to draft a Prop 2.5 override warrant article for needs-based service, to be discussed at a public hearing.
The chair said the public hearing would be arranged for March 14 and the override added to the Feb 29 and Mar 7 agendas, though the motion passed narrowly.
The committee heard Council on Aging and Library budget presentations, including meal site manager hours that would trigger benefits and a library request above the town manager's preliminary budget.
A draft grant writing services letter was deferred, with a vote set for next week and edits going only to the chair's designee.

why_it_matters: A Prop 2.5 override is a vote residents would be asked to take, and it would raise property tax bills above the levy cap, so the committee's drafting step begins that path.
Council on Aging staffing and library funding were discussed as line items in the town manager's preliminary budget, so those services' hours and appropriations are still open.
watch_next: Public hearing on the override warrant article, set for March 14, with discussion on March 7 and 14.
Committee vote on the grant writing services letter to the Select Board, expected next week.
